breakdown.description: The prompt switches from the exact thick-walled torsion relation given in the setup to a thin-walled tube approximation, which is a different model.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still uses the thin-walled closed-tube approximation (shear flow q = T/(2Aₘ), τ_max = q/t) for the maximum shear stress calculation, which is exactly the incorrect model introduced in the incomplete prompt. The ground truth requires using only the exact thick-walled torsion formula τ_max = T·(do/2)/J with J = π(do⁴ − di⁴)/32 for both quantities. While the generated spec does correctly use J for the angle of twist, it fails to fix the inconsistency for the shear stress calculation.
